definitions.explanation: Raising the rank, status, or level of something. Used for promotions in organizational hierarchy, upgrading of facilities or services, and elevation of diplomatic or institutional status.

examples.japanese: ⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{本店|ほんてん}→本店：09566_honten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{格上|かくあ}げ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The branch was upgraded to a head office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大使館|たいしかん}→大使館：01457_taishikan⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{格上|かくあ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The upgrade to an embassy has been decided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{好成績|こうせいせき}→好成績：24101_kouseiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{格上|かくあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: Following their strong performance, the team achieved promotion to the first division.

notes:
{格上|かくあ}げ means elevating the rank, status, or classification of something. Used in business, diplomacy, sports, and organizational contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格上|かくあ}げ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to upgrade, to promote
- {格上|かくあ}げ⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be upgraded
- {格上|かくあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to achieve a promotion/upgrade
- {格上|かくあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim for an upgrade

USAGE:
- Diplomacy: ⟦{大使館|たいしかん}→大使館：01457_taishikan⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{格上|かくあ}げ (upgrade to embassy status)
- Sports: ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{格上|かくあ}げ (promotion to first division)
- Business: ⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本店|ほんてん}→本店：09566_honten⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{格上|かくあ}げ (upgrade from branch to head office)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {格上|かくあ}げ: upgrade, promotion in status
- ⟦{格下|かくさ}げ→格下げ：20848_kakusage⟧: downgrade, demotion (antonym)
- ⟦{格付|かくづ}け→格付け：13121_kakuzuke⟧: rating, ranking (assigning a grade)

FORMS:
⟦{格|かく}→格：13147_kaku⟧ (status, rank) + {上|あ}げ (raising).
